LG Uplus (LGU+)
provides digital health and
remote patient monitoring (RPM)
services by integrating cellular and Bluetooth-enabled medical devices
—such as
continuous glucose monitors (CGM)
smartwatches
wearable ECGs
, and
sleep trackers
—to transmit real-time patient vitals directly to healthcare providers and mobile dashboards.
Apollo Telehealth
Core Digital Health Technologies
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGM):
Wearable subcutaneous sensors track interstitial glucose levels continuously, relaying real-time alerts and trends to mobile apps or linked smartwatches.
Amazon.in
Smartwatches & Wearable ECG:
Wrist-based units capture photoplethysmography (PPG) and electrical heart signals (ECG) to spot irregular rhythms like atrial fibrillation.
Amazon.in
Sleep Trackers:
Advanced wrist or mat sensors measure movement, heart rate variability (HRV), and oxygen saturation to assess recovery and sleep quality.
Amazon.in
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) Framework
Data Collection:
Wearables gather vital signs (glucose, heart rate, BP, SpO2) automatically.
Transmission:
Information moves securely via cellular or Bluetooth networks through a smartphone or home hub.
Clinical Intervention:
Cloud platforms aggregate the data, allowing medical teams to track chronic conditions and act on critical changes early.
